svg.text: every message on the wire, end to end — as deployed and verified on server three
Registration Request · PDU Session Establishment (DNN ims)
N7 SM Policy Create · Ipv4Address = UE IP
PDU Session Accept + PCO container 0x000C → P-CSCF address ◆ SMF
UE now holds the ims PDU session · 192.168.111.88
Nudr GET authentication-subscription · K, OPc, SQN
MILENAGE f1–f5 → RAND‖AUTN, XRES, CK, IK · SQN advanced
Nudr GET am-data · PLMN-scoped path → MSISDN
Rx AAR · Media-Component-Description · Flow-Description · Max-Requested-BW DL/UL
rx2n5 translate · GBR derived from SDP bandwidth · grant journalled to WAL
bind app-session to PDU session by exact UE IPv4 · classify IMS media as GBR ◆ PCF
N7 notify · bare callback route ◆ PCF+SMF
diff QoS against installed state · preserve AMBR · commit ◆ SMF
NAS Modification Command + NGAP ModifyRequest → 5QI-1 audio · 5QI-2 video ◆ SMF
RTP flows on the guaranteed bearer · UE ↔ UPF ↔ rtpengine ↔ UE
N5 app-session delete · dedicated bearer released
tpdu decode SUBMIT → build DELIVER · GSM-7 or UCS-2 · bounds-checked
◆ = 3GPP NF we modified to make IMS possible — 23 files across SMF, PCF and AMF, all inside the NF module · no forked openapi, nas or ngap
SETU is unmodified upstream on both faces
